entities.summary: Byzantine, a notable figure in the history of Syria, associated with Hellenistic and Roman Syria (64 BCE–636). Preceded by Roman Empire and Antioch founded — becomes one of the four great cities of the ancient world. Their legacy influenced Queen Zenobia of Palmyra briefly conquers Egypt and much of the Roman East and Battle of Yarmouk — decisive Arab victory over Byzantium opens Syria to Islam.
